CSIRO Mouse Surveillance

Winter-2018 Seasonal Summary

Published

April 24, 2026

Overview

This report summarizes house mouse monitoring activities conducted during the Winter-2018 season across Australian grain-growing regions. Mouse abundance was assessed using three complementary survey methods: live-trapping at benchmark sites, and rapid assessments using chew cards and active burrow counts.

Live-trap Surveys: A total of 810 trap nights (1 trap night = 1 trap set for 1 night) were conducted across 2 benchmark sites in 2 regions spanning 2 states (survey period: June 2018 to August 2018). These surveys captured 3 individual house mice, allowing abundance estimates at these monitoring locations.

Rapid Assessment Surveys: Rapid assessments were conducted across 8 regions using two methods. Chew card surveys deployed 845 cards across 50 sites, with 2.8% showing evidence of mouse activity (24 cards chewed). Active burrow surveys searched 377 transects across 61 sites (survey period: June 2018 to September 2018), detecting active burrows in 6.4% of transects (total: 30 active burrows).
